name: Izuna Tsukai
source: One morning, a girl woke up to find fox ears had grown on her head. As an additional surprise, she found she had gained other strange abilities such as superhuman visual acuity. She also felt a strong impulsion to murder. And then a mysterious man appeared...
translation: 一天早晨，一名少女醒来后发现自己的头上长出了狐狸耳朵。更令她吃惊的是，自己还获得了超乎常人的视力等奇异能力。与此同时，她心中也涌起一股强烈的杀人冲动。随后，一名神秘男子出现了…
